name: media_trim
description: Cut a section out of a video or audio file. Give start and end (or start and duration); times accept seconds or clock time. mode accurate (default) re-encodes for frame-exact cuts; mode fast copies the streams instantly but cuts at the nearest keyframe. The output keeps the input's format unless the output name has another extension.

input.description: Path of the video or audio file, relative to the workspace.

start.description: Where the clip begins. Default the beginning. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

end.description: Where the clip ends. Default the end. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

duration.description: Clip length, instead of end. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_trim.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

mode.description: accurate (default, frame-exact, re-encodes) or fast (instant, no re-encoding, cuts at keyframes).

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
